content.short: Ethereum VSCode Viewer lets you view the source of deployed Ethereum contracts in a VS Code browser.
content.description: Ethereum VSCode Viewer is a Web3 tool that lets you inspect the source code of deployed Ethereum contracts via a VS Code browser window. It exposes the contracts associated with searched addresses, making it possible to understand how they are implemented. By adjusting the scanner URL to .deth.dev, you can render the contract sources inside a familiar editor-like interface, enabling analysts and developers to navigate, study, and compare contract logic directly from your browser.
